title: SKILL.md Frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter block in every SKILL.md file.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier for the skill. Must start with a lowercase letter or digit.

allowed-tools.description: Explicit pre-approval list of tools this skill may invoke. May be a space-separated string or a YAML sequence of strings.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last meaningful change to the skill. Optional but validated when present.

category.description: Coarse marketplace taxonomy bucket. See docs/taxonomy.md for definitions.

lifecycle.description: Stability stage. Optional; defaults to 'stable' when absent.

disable-model-invocation.description: Optional. When true, the skill suppresses direct model invocation and relies entirely on tool calls.

liveAgentFields.description: Optional fields for live-execution skills (e.g. read-only-runtime gates). Declared at the metadata block level. See docs/live-agents/ for the full contract.

execution_tier.description: Trust posture: static-review (no execution), read-only-runtime (allowlisted Bash, no mutation), mutating-runtime (changes external state).

required_egress.description: Named hostnames the skill may contact in runtime mode. Empty array means no egress.

requires_credentials.description: Environment variable names the skill may read. Values are never collected, never echoed.

eval_fixtures.description: Repo-relative path to the golden fixture directory.
